name: Saionji Youko
source:
Saionji Youko, maiden name Inou, is [url=/c1597]Saionji Sekai[/url]'s mother. Benevolent, knowledgeable, wise and effervescent, Youko serves to provide advice and guidance to her daughter when necessary, especially concerning her relationships. She is a restaurateur of Radish with friend, and slight rival, [url=/c7644]Kiyoura Mai[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_School_Days_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
